t: This is Leyton Parish Church, a Church of England church in east London. Records of a church here go back to about 1200, but it has been rebuilt many times. The oldest surviving fabric dates from 1658, and most of what you see is early nineteenth century. It's Grade II star listed. The people buried here are largely City figures and officials. Robert Beachcroft was a cloth merchant and Lord Mayor of London in 1711. Sir Fisher Tench was a financier and Member of Parliament. Sir Michael Hicks was secretary to Lord Burghley under Elizabeth the First. Thomas Bladen, once Governor of Maryland, is buried here too.
